title: Faster cobwebs
description: This plugin removes the cobweb slowdown mechanic by setting the cobweb to air temporarily
body:
This plugin removes the delay of cobwebs by replacing them with air on contact, then replacing it. Report bugs to my discord _cyproheptadine_. Also, Not reccomended for PVP servers, as cobwebs are used in those, and it would ruin that type of PVP. 

**THIS PLUGIN IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT**
